title: HealthSnapshot
description: Explainable engine health score derived from twin state. Producer: M3 (Health Monitoring). Consumers: M5, M6.

trend.description: Direction of healthScore over the recent window.

violatedRules.description: IDs of health rules currently violated, e.g. ['RULE_OIL_TEMP_HIGH'].

reasonCodes.description: Human-readable reason codes explaining the score, e.g. ['Oil temperature 12C above safe envelope'].

ruleVersion.description: Version of the rule/threshold set used for this snapshot.

dataQualityIssue.description: True if the score is uncertain due to sensor/data quality problems rather than genuine engine health.
